Workload_Description: Finds the keys and relationships in a lakehouse, lets you review them, and builds an API for GraphQL from what you accepted.
Workload_Hub_Slogan: Keys and relationships for your lakehouse tables, with the rule behind each one.
Workload_Hub_Description:
Krusgraph reads the table and column names of a lakehouse and proposes keys and relationships, each with the rule that found it. You accept or reject each one, see a dry run, and create an API for GraphQL in the same workspace.

**In this version:**

• Choose a lakehouse in the workspace.
• Review keys and relationships; open items come first.
• See what would be created before anything is.
• Create an API for GraphQL. Semantic models, reports and pipelines come later.
Workload_Hub_GetStarted_1_Description: Create a Krusgraph Model from New item, choose a lakehouse and review what was found.
ModelItem_Description: Review the keys and relationships of a lakehouse and create an API for GraphQL from them.
